plans.rationale: This is the first round of investigation for INC-12. We need to establish the exact symptom onset, examine error logs and metrics for the symptomatic services (payments-api, upi-gateway), and review all recent changes across the entire system around the reported 14:05/14:08 window, as well as the dependency map.

tasks.goal: Establish exact symptom onset, error rates, and log error messages for payments-api and upi-gateway between 13:50 and 14:40.

Review all deploys, config changes, and feature flags across all services over the last 7 days, with special attention to changes around 14:05, and fetch the dependency map around payments-api and upi-gateway.
Establish exact symptom onset, error rates, and log error messages for payments-api and upi-gateway between 13:50 and 14:40.

Review all deploys, config changes, and feature flags across all services over the last 7 days, with special attention to changes around 14:05, and fetch the dependency map around payments-api and upi-gateway.
Build and rank competing root-cause hypotheses

r1-observability-1.summary: Both payments-api and upi-gateway experienced a sudden surge in error rates starting at 14:07 UTC on 2026-10-07, reaching peaks around 8.9% and 10.3% respectively. Logs show payments-api failing due to upi-gateway U30 route failures, while upi-gateway fails due to partner-bank-api returning 404 Not Found for @okbank handles.

findings.statement: The error rate anomaly for payments-api began at 2026-10-07T14:07:00+00:00, rising from a baseline under 0.4% to a peak of 8.89%.
The error rate anomaly for upi-gateway began at 2026-10-07T14:07:00+00:00, rising from a baseline under 0.5% to a peak of 10.28%.
payments-api logged repeated errors stating 'UPI collect failed: upi-gateway error U30 (route failure)' starting at 14:07:07 UTC.
upi-gateway logged repeated errors stating 'partner-bank-api POST /v3/collect returned 404 Not Found for handle' starting at 14:07:03 UTC.

open_questions: Why did partner-bank-api start returning 404 Not Found for @okbank handles starting at 14:07 UTC?

r1-dependency-2.summary: Mapped dependencies around payments-api, upi-gateway, and npci-switch, and retrieved all deployments, config changes, and feature flags over the last 7 days. Identified two changes occurring near the incident start time (~14:08): payments-api deploy v2.15.0 (chg-9649) at 14:05 and upi-gateway routing config change (chg-9824) moving @okbank handles to partner-bank-api /v3/collect at 14:06.

findings.statement: payments-api depends synchronously on ledger-service, upi-gateway, fraud-service, and redis-cache, and asynchronously on event-bus.
upi-gateway depends synchronously on npci-switch and partner-bank-api.
A deploy for payments-api (v2.15.0) occurred at 2026-10-07T14:05:00+00:00 (chg-9649).
A routing table config update for upi-gateway moved @okbank handles to partner-bank-api /v3/collect at 2026-10-07T14:06:00+00:00 (chg-9824).

open_questions: Did the routing config update (chg-9824) misroute @okbank traffic to /v3/collect before partner-bank-api was ready to handle it?

hypotheses.title: Routing Configuration Update Sent @okbank Traffic to Incorrect Endpoint
hypotheses.mechanism: The routing table config update moved @okbank handles to partner-bank-api /v3/collect, but partner-bank-api does not support or have /v3/collect configured, resulting in 404 errors, upi-gateway route failures, and payments-api transaction failures.

supporting.note: Config update at 14:06 moved @okbank handles to partner-bank-api /v3/collect, immediately preceding the anomaly.
Error rate spiked starting at 14:07, right after the config change.
upi-gateway logged 404 Not Found from partner-bank-api POST /v3/collect starting at 14:07.
payments-api logged UPI collect failed due to upi-gateway error U30 (route failure) starting at 14:07.

assumptions: partner-bank-api does not have /v3/collect deployed or active for @okbank handles.

hypotheses.title: Payments-API v2.15.0 Deploy Caused Request Formatting Incompatibility
hypotheses.mechanism: The payments-api deployment introduced an incompatible payload or routing call format that caused upi-gateway to fail routing.

supporting.note: payments-api v2.15.0 was deployed at 14:05, just before the incident.

contradicting.note: Error logs explicitly show partner-bank-api returning 404 Not Found on /v3/collect, indicating a downstream routing and endpoint issue rather than a client-side formatting bug.
The routing table update for @okbank explicitly targeted partner-bank-api /v3/collect precisely at 14:06, aligning with the 14:07 error onset.

assumptions: The deployment changes in v2.15.0 affected outbound call parameters to upi-gateway.

hypotheses.reasoning_summary: Both payments-api and upi-gateway experienced a sudden surge in error rates starting precisely at 14:07 UTC. Two changes occurred just prior: payments-api deploy (chg-9649) at 14:05 and upi-gateway routing config update (chg-9824) moving @okbank handles to /v3/collect at 14:06. Logs explicitly show upi-gateway failing with 404 Not Found from partner-bank-api POST /v3/collect and payments-api failing with upi-gateway error U30 (route failure). This strongly supports H1 (routing config error pointing to an invalid/unready endpoint) over H2.

adjustments.reason: Direct evidence from chg-9824 demonstrates that the routing table update moved @okbank handles to /v3/collect precisely one minute before error onset, and log-00788 confirms partner-bank-api returned 404 Not Found on that exact endpoint.
Contradicted by direct logs showing downstream 404 errors from partner-bank-api rather than client-side formatting issues.
